article_title: How the bare nails trend became a class issue

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main argument about the bare-nails trend?
options: A seemingly simple beauty choice has become entangled with ideas about wealth, taste, class and cultural identity.
Bare nails are medically healthier for every person in every circumstance.
Nail polish has disappeared because it is no longer manufactured.
The trend matters only because celebrities dislike bright colours.
tasks.correct_answer: A seemingly simple beauty choice has become entangled with ideas about wealth, taste, class and cultural identity.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה טוענת שהמראה ה״טבעי״ אינו רק בחירה אסתטית; הדיון סביבו קושר בין טעם, מעמד, עושר וזהות תרבותית.

tasks.prompt: Why can “bare” nails still represent luxury rather than a lack of effort?
options: Natural nails cannot be maintained at home.
The polished natural look may require time, healthy nails, grooming and professional care.
Only members of the nobility are legally allowed to wear them.
The look always includes expensive coloured extensions.
tasks.correct_answer: The polished natural look may require time, healthy nails, grooming and professional care.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המראה נראה חסר מאמץ, אך עשוי לדרוש טיפוח, זמן ומשאבים—ולכן הוא יכול לתפקד כסימן למותרות.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean to “conflate” bare nails with good taste?
options: To measure the cost of two manicure styles
To copy a celebrity's exact nail shape
To treat a particular nail style and refined taste as though they were the same thing
To remove every product from the nails
tasks.correct_answer: To treat a particular nail style and refined taste as though they were the same thing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: conflate פירושו לערבב שני רעיונות שונים ולהציגם כאילו הם זהים—כאן, מראה ציפורניים מסוים ו״טעם טוב״.

tasks.prompt: Which historical pattern does the article use to challenge the idea that nail fashion is socially neutral?
options: Nails have always been unrelated to work or status.
Colourful nails were invented only after social media.
Every culture has treated long nails as a sign of poverty.
Nail colour and length have previously signalled hierarchy, wealth or freedom from manual labour.
tasks.correct_answer: Nail colour and length have previously signalled hierarchy, wealth or freedom from manual labour.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציבה את הטרנד בתוך היסטוריה שבה צבע ואורך הציפורניים סימנו היררכיה, עושר והיעדר עבודה ידנית.

tasks.prompt: Why do critics describe the trend's language as potentially classist?
options: Calling one restrained style “refined” can stigmatise expressive nail art and the communities associated with it.
Bare nails require a government licence.
The trend prevents people from buying any beauty products.
All professional nail artists oppose natural nails.
tasks.correct_answer: Calling one restrained style “refined” can stigmatise expressive nail art and the communities associated with it.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר מראה מאופק מתואר כ״מעודן״ או ״יקר״, סגנונות בולטים עלולים להיות מתויגים כזולים ובכך להנציח הבדלים מעמדיים ותרבותיים.

tasks.prompt: In the article's argument, what would “cultural erasure” mean?
options: Removing old polish before a manicure
Forgetting the name of a viral trend
Reducing the cost of beauty treatments
Ignoring or wiping away the cultural history and meaning of expressive nail art
tasks.correct_answer: Ignoring or wiping away the cultural history and meaning of expressive nail art
tasks.explanation_hebrew: erasure בהקשר זה היא מחיקה או טשטוש של ההיסטוריה והמשמעות התרבותית של אמנות ציפורניים בולטת.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons discussed for why people may choose bare or nearly bare nails.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי סיבות שונות מן הכתבה ולהסביר בקצרה כיצד כל אחת מובילה לבחירה במראה הטבעי.
expected_points: Some people want healthier nails after damage from gels, acrylics or repeated manicures.
Busy people may not have the time or mental bandwidth for regular salon appointments.
The cost of repeated manicures can make a simple look attractive during economic pressure.
Some people prefer the minimalist or quiet-luxury aesthetic.
Others may be responding to beauty fatigue and constant consumer trends.

tasks.prompt: How can the same bare-nails look communicate opposite class messages?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הסתירה: מצד אחד זמן, טיפוח ו״עושר שקט״; מצד אחר חיסכון בכסף ובזמן בתקופה כלכלית קשה.
expected_points: For wealthy consumers, immaculate natural nails may signal time, health investment and freedom from obvious display.
For others, skipping salon appointments may reflect limited money or time.
Social media can frame identical choices differently depending on who wears the look and how it is described.
The meaning comes from social interpretation, not from the nails alone.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how the article connects beauty trends, class and cultural expression.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את עליית המראה הטבעי, את קישורו לעושר ולטעם, את הביקורת המעמדית ואת חשיבות אמנות הציפורניים כביטוי תרבותי.
expected_points: Bare or barely polished nails have become a prominent beauty trend.
Online discourse presents the look as effortless, refined or a marker of status.
Critics argue that this can label colourful styles as tacky and reproduce class-based standards.
Expressive nail art has cultural histories and meanings that should not be erased.
Individual preference is different from treating one aesthetic as morally or socially superior.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, evaluate whether calling bare nails “good taste” is harmless fashion language.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג עמדה מורכבת, להשתמש בלפחות שתי ראיות או דוגמאות מן הכתבה, להתייחס לבחירה אישית ולסיים במסקנה על כוחן של מילות טעם ומעמד.
expected_points: The phrase may describe a genuine personal preference for simplicity or nail health.
However, taste labels can operate as euphemisms for class and privilege.
Calling restraint refined may stigmatise bold styles and the people or cultures associated with them.
Historical examples show that nail appearance has long been used to communicate social rank.
A strong response should separate freedom to choose bare nails from claims that they are inherently superior.
